# Overview

How does P(yes) change over time, if we do not force a straight line (on the log-odds scale)?
Groups only; the two parent questions and the 36 child questions (conditional). No traditions (for now).

| model | formula |
|---|---|
| linear | `0 + Intercept + time + (1 | world_region)` |
| smooth | `s(time) + (1 | world_region)` |

- time: `year_from` / 1000 (0 = 0 CE)
- `s(time)`: thin plate regression spline (brms/mgcv default, k = 10 basis functions). The wiggliness is
  estimated from the data (SD of the spline coefficients, `sds`); a small SD gives an almost straight line.
- priors: intercept normal(0, 1.5), linear slope normal(0, 1), SDs (world region, spline) exponential(1)
- conflicting answers weighted 1/n; all entries kept (early and long entries: the smooth can bend where there
  are few entries, see the number of entries per period)

Run from inside `modeling/` after `3_prepare_data.py`. Fits are saved in `fits/` (delete them to refit),
figures in `fig/time/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)

options(mc.cores = 4, brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))

# figures: shown in the session and saved as fig/time/<name>.jpg
fig_dir <- "fig/time"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_plot <- function(p, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".jpg")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  p
}

model_colors <- c(linear = "#898781", smooth = "#2a78d6")
```

# Data

```{r data, message = FALSE}
d <- read_csv("data/model_data.csv") |>
  mutate(time = year_from / 1000)

parent_questions <- c("supernatural monitoring present", "supreme high god present")
topic_order <- c(
  "murder coreligionists", "murder other religions", "murder other polities", "non-lethal fighting",
  "prosocial norm adherence", "lying", "honouring oaths", "property crimes", "economic fairness",
  "gossiping", "laziness", "shirking risk", "disrespecting elders", "sex",
  "ritual observance", "performance of rituals", "taboos", "personal hygiene", "sorcery",
  "conversion non-religionists",
  "knowledge this world", "causal efficacy the world", "indirect causal efficacy the world", "communicates with living",
  "is unquestionably good", "positive emotion", "negative emotion",
  "is anthropomorphic", "possesses hunger", "is sky deity", "is chthonic",
  "permissible to worship other god?",
  "is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty"
)
all_questions <- c(parent_questions, topic_order)

questions <- d |>
  distinct(family, question_short) |>
  filter(question_short %in% all_questions) |>
  mutate(family = factor(family, levels = c("parent", "monitoring", "shg")))

# groups only: parent questions and child questions (conditional)
d_model <- d |>
  filter(poll == "group") |>
  filter(question_short %in% parent_questions | (family != "parent" & !inferred))
```

Entries per period (all questions together; `year_from`):

```{r data_periods}
periods <- c(-Inf, -1000, -500, 0, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, 1500, 1750, Inf)
period_mid <- c(-1500, -750, -250, 125, 375, 625, 875, 1125, 1375, 1625, 1875)  # where the points are drawn

d_model |>
  distinct(entry_id, year_from) |>
  mutate(period = cut(year_from, periods, dig.lab = 5)) |>
  count(period)
```

# Models

```{r models}
formulas <- list(
  linear = bf(answer_value | weights(weight) ~ 0 + Intercept + time + (1 | world_region)),
  smooth = bf(answer_value | weights(weight) ~ s(time) + (1 | world_region))
)

priors <- list(
  linear = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "Intercept"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
  ),
  smooth = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),        # linear part of the spline
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sds")     # wiggliness of the spline
  )
)
```

# Fit

Each model is compiled once (`chains = 0`) and then refit for each question with `update()`.

```{r fit, message = FALSE, results = "hide"}
templates <- map(names(formulas), function(m) {
  suppressWarnings(brm(formulas[[m]], data = d_model, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors[[m]], chains = 0, refresh = 0, silent = 2))
}) |> set_names(names(formulas))

fit_question <- function(model, question) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/time_%s_%s.rds", model, question)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  fit <- update(
    templates[[model]],
    newdata = filter(d_model, question_short == question),
    chains = 4, iter = 2000, seed = 2026, refresh = 0,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 12)
  )
  saveRDS(fit, path)
  fit
}

fits <- crossing(model = names(formulas), question = all_questions) |>
  mutate(fit = map2(model, question, fit_question), model = factor(model, levels = names(formulas)))
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
diagnostics <- fits |>
  mutate(diag = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_|^bs_|^sd_|^sds_", regex = TRUE))
    tibble(
      max_rhat = max(s$rhat),
      min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk),
      min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail),
      divergences = sum(subset(nuts_params(fit), Parameter == "divergent__")$Value)
    )
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(diag)

# worst values per model
diagnostics |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(max_rhat = max(max_rhat), min_ess_bulk = min(min_ess_bulk), min_ess_tail = min(min_ess_tail), divergences = sum(divergences))

# fits with any problem
diagnostics |> filter(max_rhat > 1.01 | min_ess_bulk < 400 | min_ess_tail < 400 | divergences > 0)
```

# Curves

P(yes) over time (average world region; mean and 95% interval) for the linear and the smooth model, with the
observed share yes per period (points; weighted; size = number of entries). Shown from 3000 BCE.

```{r predictions}
grid <- tibble(time = seq(-3, 2, by = 0.025), weight = 1)

preds <- fits |>
  mutate(
    epred = map(fit, ~ posterior_epred(.x, newdata = grid, re_formula = NA, ndraws = 1000)),
    linpred = map(fit, ~ posterior_linpred(.x, newdata = grid, re_formula = NA, ndraws = 1000))
  )

curves <- preds |>
  mutate(curve = map(epred, ~ grid |> mutate(
    mean = colMeans(.x), lower = apply(.x, 2, quantile, 0.025), upper = apply(.x, 2, quantile, 0.975)
  ))) |>
  select(model, question, curve) |>
  unnest(curve)

observed <- d_model |>
  mutate(period = cut(year_from, periods, labels = period_mid)) |>
  group_by(question = question_short, period) |>
  summarise(yes = weighted.mean(answer_value, weight), n = n_distinct(entry_id), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(as.character(period)))
```

```{r curves, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 20}
p_curves <- ggplot(curves, aes(time * 1000)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = model), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean, colour = model)) +
  geom_point(data = observed, aes(year, yes, size = n), colour = "grey30", alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(question, levels = all_questions), ncol = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_colors) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year (year_from)", y = "P(yes)", colour = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
save_plot(p_curves, "curves", 12, 20)
```

# Rate of change

Slope of the smooth curve over time (derivative of the log-odds; per 1,000 years; mean and 95% interval),
with the linear slope (grey, constant). Shaded: periods where the 95% interval of the smooth slope excludes 0.

```{r derivatives}
# slope per draw: difference of the linear predictor between neighbouring grid points
step <- diff(grid$time)[1]
derivatives <- preds |>
  filter(model == "smooth") |>
  mutate(deriv = map(linpred, function(lp) {
    slope <- (lp[, -1] - lp[, -ncol(lp)]) / step
    tibble(
      time = (grid$time[-1] + grid$time[-nrow(grid)]) / 2,
      mean = colMeans(slope), lower = apply(slope, 2, quantile, 0.025), upper = apply(slope, 2, quantile, 0.975)
    )
  })) |>
  select(question, deriv) |>
  unnest(deriv) |>
  mutate(change = case_when(lower > 0 ~ "increase", upper < 0 ~ "decrease", TRUE ~ NA_character_))

linear_slopes <- fits |>
  filter(model == "linear") |>
  mutate(est = map(fit, ~ summarise_draws(as_draws_df(.x, variable = "b_time"), mean, ~ quantile(.x, c(0.025, 0.975))))) |>
  select(question, est) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  rename(lower = `2.5%`, upper = `97.5%`)
```

```{r derivative_plot, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 20}
p_derivatives <- ggplot(derivatives, aes(time * 1000)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = filter(derivatives, !is.na(change)),
    aes(xmin = time * 1000 - step * 500, xmax = time * 1000 + step * 500, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = change),
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_rect(data = linear_slopes, aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = lower, ymax = upper), inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_hline(data = linear_slopes, aes(yintercept = mean), colour = "grey40", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "#2a78d6", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean), colour = "#2a78d6") +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(question, levels = all_questions), ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(increase = "#eb6834", decrease = "#2a78d6")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-4, 4)) +
  labs(x = "Year (year_from)", y = "Slope (log-odds per 1,000 years)", fill = "95% interval excludes 0") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
save_plot(p_derivatives, "derivatives", 12, 20)
```

Wiggliness of the smooth (SD of the spline coefficients; small = close to a straight line):

```{r wiggliness, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 10}
wiggliness <- fits |>
  filter(model == "smooth") |>
  mutate(est = map(fit, ~ summarise_draws(as_draws_df(.x, variable = "^sds_", regex = TRUE), mean, ~ quantile(.x, c(0.025, 0.975))))) |>
  select(question, est) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  rename(lower = `2.5%`, upper = `97.5%`) |>
  left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions)))

p_wiggliness <- ggplot(wiggliness, aes(mean, question)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), size = 0.2, colour = "#2a78d6") +
  facet_grid(family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "SD of spline coefficients (sds)", y = NULL)
save_plot(p_wiggliness, "wiggliness", 8, 10)
```

# Model comparison (LOO)

Smooth vs. linear (elpd difference; positive = smooth predicts better; 95% interval as ±1.96 SE).

```{r loo}
loo_question <- function(model, question, fit) {
  path <- sprintf("fits/time_loo_%s_%s.rds", model, question)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  l <- loo(fit)
  saveRDS(l, path)
  l
}
loos <- fits |> mutate(loo = pmap(list(as.character(model), question, fit), loo_question))

# Pareto k > 0.7 (unreliable LOO estimate) per model
loos |>
  mutate(high_k = map_int(loo, ~ sum(.x$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7))) |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(fits_with_high_k = sum(high_k > 0), observations_high_k = sum(high_k))

loo_diffs <- loos |>
  select(model, question, loo) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = loo) |>
  mutate(diff = map2(smooth, linear, function(a, b) {
    d <- a$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"] - b$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"]
    tibble(mean = sum(d), se = sqrt(length(d)) * sd(d))
  })) |>
  select(question, diff) |>
  unnest(diff) |>
  left_join(questions, by = c("question" = "question_short")) |>
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = rev(all_questions)))
```

```{r loo_plot, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 10}
p_loo <- ggplot(loo_diffs, aes(mean, question)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = mean - 1.96 * se, xmax = mean + 1.96 * se), size = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "elpd difference (smooth - linear)", y = NULL)
save_plot(p_loo, "loo", 7, 10)
```

# Posterior predictive check

Observed share yes (points) against the 95% posterior predictive interval (bars) per period, for both models.

```{r ppc}
ppc_period <- function(fit, data) {
  yrep <- posterior_predict(fit, ndraws = 1000)
  map_dfr(levels(droplevels(data$period)), function(p) {
    w <- data$weight * (data$period == p)
    prop <- as.vector(yrep %*% w) / sum(w)
    tibble(period = p, observed = sum(w * data$answer_value) / sum(w),
           lower = quantile(prop, 0.025), upper = quantile(prop, 0.975))
  })
}

period_labels <- levels(cut(0, periods, dig.lab = 5))
ppc <- fits |>
  mutate(check = map2(fit, question, ~ ppc_period(.x, filter(d_model, question_short == .y) |>
    mutate(period = cut(year_from, periods, dig.lab = 5))))) |>
  select(model, question, check) |>
  unnest(check)
```

```{r ppc_plot, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 24}
p_ppc <- ppc |>
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = rev(period_labels))) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = period, colour = model)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), linewidth = 2, alpha = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = observed), size = 1.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(question, levels = all_questions), ncol = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colors) +
  labs(x = "Share yes", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
save_plot(p_ppc, "ppc_period", 12, 24)
```

Share of observed values outside the 95% interval:

```{r ppc_summary}
ppc |>
  mutate(outside = observed < lower | observed > upper) |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(groups = n(), share_outside = round(mean(outside), 2), outside = sum(outside), .groups = "drop")
```
